<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<EmailTemplate xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <available>true</available>
    <description>Invite a contact to a Commerce Reorder Portal.</description>
    <encodingKey>UTF-8</encodingKey>
    <name>Commerce Reorder Portal: Invitation</name>
    <style>none</style>
    <subject>Welcome to {!Community_Name}</subject>
    <textOnly><html>
            Dear {!Receiving_User.FirstName},
            <p>
            Check out this reorder portal for a simpler way to place repeat orders with {!Organization.Name}. You can view your past orders, modify quantities, place new orders, and view order statuses.
            </p>
            <p>
            Click the link for access: <a href={!Community_URL}>{!Community_Name}</a>
            </p>
            Regards,<br>
            {!Sending_User.Name}
            </html></textOnly>
    <type>custom</type>
    <uiType>Aloha</uiType>
</EmailTemplate>
